title: NCAA: Cargo impresses as Letran overwhelms EAC to stay unbeaten
summary: Justin Cargo impressed as Colegio de San Juan de Letran overwhelmed Emilio Aguinaldo College, 91-80, to stay unbeaten in NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball on Thursday at the FilOil Centre in San Juan.
